joinusPageSubtitle: The [Robot Autonomy Lab](/) is seeking passionate students, researchers, and engineers to join our mission of advancing mobile-robot autonomy. Opportunities include graduate and undergraduate research positions, internships, and collaborative projects. Check out our other pages or contact us to explore how you can contribute to cutting-edge robotics innovation!

joinusData.text: The [Robot Autonomy Lab](/) is currently recruiting **one MSc** and **one PhD** student to join our team starting **Fall 2026**. Both positions comes with **full scholarships**. To apply, please submit the following documents to [j.wang@umanitoba.ca](mailto:j.wang@umanitoba.ca) with the subject line **"RAL2026 - \[Your Name\]"**:

For application deadlines and program details, please visit [University of Manitoba - Mechanical Engineering Graduate Programs](https://umanitoba.ca/explore/programs-of-study/mechanical-engineering-phd).
